prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a lively school science fair. On the left, a boy in a blue cap stands beside his project. In the center, a girl with pigtails points at a bubbling beaker on a table. Next to her on the right, a teacher in a green cardigan looks at the experiment with interest. A small gray cat sits on the floor near the table leg, watching the scene. A red balloon floats above the center display, tethered by a thin string. The boy in the blue cap is handing a worksheet to the girl with pigtails. The teacher in the green cardigan is standing next to the girl with pigtails. There is no chalkboard in the background.
